items.jobTitle: Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) – Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems
items.companyName: AIT AUSTRIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY GMBH
items.jobDescription:
As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. To achieve our goals, we rely on our specific research, development, and technology competencies, which are the basis of our commitment to excellence in all areas. With our open culture of innovation and our motivated, international teams, we are working to position AIT as Austria's leading research institution at the highest international level and to make a positive contribution to the economy and society.
 Our Center for Energy is looking for new Ingenious Partner for our location in Vienna . At the Center for Energy , we work on solutions for the sustainable energy system of the future and, a particular focus lies on the development of power electronics converters for mobile applications (electric vehicles, ships, aviation) as well as grid-tied renewable energy solutions.
 Our team Power Electronics & System Components covers the whole range of power electronics system development from development of novel solutions for the electricity grid, via specification and prototyping towards system test and validation and beyond. With successful collaborative research projects from emerging technologies up to demonstration we position ourselves as a reliable partner for industry.
 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) – Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems
 CENTER FOR ENERGY 
 As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV.
 You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.
 You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools.
 You define power-stage architectures , including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures.
 You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration.
 You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 You work on research and development projects , prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.
 Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: 
 Master’s or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
 Several years of experience in power electronic systems
 Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies.
 Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management.
 Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred)
 Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems.
 Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis
 Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems
 Very good English skills (spoken and written); German skills are a nice to have.
 What to expect: 
 The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions (incl. Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities.
 Mentorship and training in embedded firmware and power systems
 The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment.
 At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.
 Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.

Arbeitsort: Altenstadt, Bayern Vertragsart: unbefristeter Vertrag
Einstiegslevel: Berufserfahrene 
Home Office: anteilig möglich
Stellen-ID: 1306 Job teilen: [](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=https://career.vincorion.com/jobposting/32c2b021eb8e12c8afd397becabc63d096687263) [](https://www.xing-share.com/app/user?op=share;sc_p=xing-share;url=https://career.vincorion.com/jobposting/32c2b021eb8e12c8afd397becabc63d096687263) [](mailto:e5e7690_n51i986g9z_1-0@career.vincorion.com?subject=e5e7690_n51i986g9z_1-0@career.vincorion.com?subject=Bewerbung%3A%20Software%20Ingenieur%20%28all%20genders%29%20-%20in%20Voll-%20und%20Teilzeit-&body=https://career.vincorion.com/jobposting/32c2b021eb8e12c8afd397becabc63d096687263) 
## Über VINCORION
Bei **VINCORION** arbeiten Menschen, denen die Sicherheit anderer am Herzen liegt. Und die von diesem Ziel angetrieben gemeinsam das Beste aus sich herausholen. Für unsere mechatronischen Lösungen leistet bei uns jeder und jede Einzelne seinen bzw. ihren individuellen Beitrag für die Sicherheit der Gesellschaft und ist damit nicht nur ein Gewinn für uns, sondern für alle.
Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln und fertigen wir mit rund 900 Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Altenstadt, Essen, Wedel und El Paso in Texas innovative Energiesysteme in sicherheitskritischen Anwendungsbereichen, darunter Generatoren, elektrische Motoren und Antriebe, Aggregate, Leistungselektronik und hybride Energiesysteme für die Industrien Luftfahrt, Sicherheit und Verteidigung sowie Bahn. Darüber hinaus sind wir One-Stop-Repair-Shop mit maßgeschneiderten, wirtschaftlichen Servicekonzepten verschiedenster Systeme – herstellerunabhängig.
#wirsindVINCORION – Wann können wir dich für uns gewinnen? 
[www.vincorion.com/karriere](http://www.vincorion.com/karriere)
## Deine Aufgaben:
Du hast Spaß am Systemischen Denken mit Blick auf das Gesamtsystem, arbeitest gerne mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen, kennst das V-Model und arbeitest gerne im Bereich der Verteidigung. Dann bist Du genau die richtige Ergänzung für unser Software Engineering Team
- **Software-Entwicklung:** Du entwickelst hardwarenahe Software und Treiber in **C** (Bare-Metal oder RTOS).
- **Modellbasierte Entwicklung:** Du integrierst **Matlab Simulink** Output (z.B. komplexe Regler-Algorithmen) in unsere SPS-ähnliche Software-Architektur.
- **Hardware-Integration:** Du bringst den Code auf die Ziel-Hardware und führst Fehleranalysen direkt am System durch.
- **Leistungselektronik:** Du kümmerst dich um die Ansteuerung von Elektromotoren (PWM-Generierung, Sensor-Interfaces).
- **Qualität:** Durch effizienten, ressourcensparenden Code und strukturierte Unit-Tests stellst du die Performance unserer Systeme sicher.
## Unser VIN:
- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektro- oder Informationstechnik, technischen Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der hardwarenahen Softwareentwicklung.
- **C-Experte** mit einem Blick für optimierten Code auf Mikrocontrollern.
- Sicherer Umgang mit Schaltplänen, Oszilloskop und Logic Analyzer.
- Fundiertes Wissen in der Antriebstechnik (Wechselrichter, EMV, Regelungstechnik).
- Leidenschaft für die technische Umsetzung „nahe am Motor“.
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse für die interne Abstimmung sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die technische Dokumentation
## Dein VIN:
Was dich bei VINCORION in Altenstadt erwartet:
- Mitgestalten: Ob in der Entwicklung, Fertigung, Instandhaltung oder im Projekt – du trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass sicherheitsrelevante Technologien entstehen, funktionieren und weiterentwickelt werden.
- Verantwortung übernehmen: Du arbeitest nicht nur Aufgaben ab, sondern beeinflusst Qualität, Prozesse und Ergebnisse direkt – sichtbar und messbar.
- Starke Rahmenbedingungen: Tarifgebundene Vergütung, Urlaubs‑ & Weihnachtsgeld sowie 30 Tage Urlaub.
- Flexibles Arbeiten: Moderne Arbeitszeiten und – je nach Tätigkeit – Mobile‑Office‑Option.
- Weiterkommen durch Können: Schulungen, Englischkurse und regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche unterstützen dich dabei, fachlich wie praktisch immer besser zu werden.
- Effiziente Mobilität: JobRad‑Leasing, kostenlose Parkplätze und gute Anbindung aus der Region.
- Ein Team, das anpackt: Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Lösungen finden und gemeinsam Ergebnisse liefern – egal ob im Büro oder in der Produktion.
- Zukunftssichere Perspektive: Ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt, in Technologie investiert und Menschen sucht, die etwas bewegen wollen.
Und vieles mehr erklären wir gern im Gespräch.
Die Vergütung erfolgt nach dem Tarifvertrag der Metall‑ und Elektroindustrie, Bayern. Das Bruttojahresentgelt liegt zum Start bei ca. 67.000 € bei einer Wochenarbeitszeit von 35 Stunden. Zusätzlich gelten weitere Sonderzahlungen gemäß Tarifvertrag. Der Anspruch darauf variiert abhängig von der Dauer der Betriebszugehörigkeit zum jeweiligen Stichtag.
### KONTAKT
HUMAN RESOURCES 
Birgit Cordes

 Bei BorgWarner arbeiten wir an den Mobilitäts- und Energiesystemen der Zukunft. Für unser Entwicklungsteam suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die die Entwicklung innovativer Softwarelösungen für anspruchsvolle technische Anwendungen unterstützt.

 Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung; für die Einstufung als Engineer II entsprechend weiterführende einschlägige Erfahrung.

 Kenntnisse oder erste Erfahrung mit MATLAB/Simulink und modellbasierter Softwareentwicklung.

 Abwechslungsreiche Embedded-Software-Themen mit Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung.
 Mitarbeit entlang des gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozesses.
 Enge Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären und internationalen Umfeld.
 Die Möglichkeit, moderne Entwicklungs-, Test- und Automatisierungsansätze aktiv mitzugestalten.

We Are 
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 
 You Are 
 You have spent years working at the intersection of aerospace engineering and real-world problem solving, and you understand that the best simulation is the one that actually gets used to make decisions. You know the difference between a demo that impresses and a workflow that changes how a customer designs their next satellite or defense platform. Your technical depth in modeling complex systems is matched by your ability to sit across from a program director and explain why digital mission engineering matters to their timeline, their budget, and their mission success. 
 You are comfortable moving between writing Python scripts for orbital mechanics and presenting to a C-level stakeholder without losing the thread of what you are actually solving. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, map customer workflows, and find the path through ambiguity that leads to adoption, not just a signed contract. 
 You have worked in aerospace and defense long enough to know what good looks like. RF propagation, trajectory optimization, systems integration across disciplines. You care about getting it right because the systems you help design have consequences. At Synopsys, you will work with customers building the next generation of space, air, and defense systems, and the solutions you deliver will shape how they engineer those missions. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Lead technical engagements with aerospace and defense customers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery to deployment, translating their mission requirements into simulation solutions using tools like STK, ODTK, and multiphysics platforms
 Demonstrate technical mastery in digital mission engineering, modeling complex aerospace systems including satellites, launch vehicles, aircraft, radar systems, and sensor networks to solve real customer design challenges
 Work directly with Korean A&D customers to understand their engineering workflows, business initiatives, and design constraints, then configure and deliver solutions that integrate into their product development lifecycle
 Gather, document, and present metrics that quantify the impact of your technical work, showing ROI, workflow improvements, and engineering outcomes to both technical teams and executive stakeholders
 Collaborate with product development teams to translate customer feedback and requirements into product roadmap priorities, ensuring Synopsys solutions evolve to meet real-world aerospace and defense needs
 Mentor junior application engineers on technical depth, customer engagement strategies, and aerospace domain knowledge, raising the capability of the broader team
 Support marketing efforts by authoring technical papers, delivering webinars, and presenting at conferences on aerospace simulation topics, establishing thought leadership in the Korean defense sector
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Accelerate the adoption of digital mission engineering across Korea's defense sector, enabling faster, more reliable design cycles for mission-critical systems
 Drive measurable customer success and retention by delivering solutions that integrate seamlessly into existing workflows and produce tangible engineering outcomes
 Expand Synopsys market share in aerospace and defense applications by demonstrating technical credibility and delivering value that competitors cannot match
 Influence the product roadmap with real-world feedback from the field, ensuring future releases solve the problems customers actually face
 Build long-term strategic relationships with key defense and aerospace organizations, positioning Synopsys as the trusted partner for mission engineering
 Elevate the technical capability and customer impact of the broader applications engineering team through mentorship and knowledge sharing
 Establish Synopsys as a thought leader in model-based systems engineering and digital mission engineering within the Korean aerospace community
 What You'll Need 
 Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Aerospace, Astronautical, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline
 5-7 years of hands-on experience modeling and simulating complex aerospace systems such as space launch vehicles, satellites, aircraft, or defense platforms
 Fluency in both Korean and English, written and spoken, with the ability to lead technical discussions and present to executives in both languages
 Proficiency in object-oriented programming with practical experience in Python, MATLAB, C#, or Java for building and customizing simulation workflows
 Deep familiarity with communications, radar, and sensor systems including RF propagation, link analysis, jamming, interference, detection, and tracking
 Demonstrated experience with aerospace engineering practices, product development lifecycles, and deploying simulation solutions into customer engineering workflows
 Experience with Ansys Digital Mission Engineering software such as STK or ODTK is strongly preferred, as is familiarity with model-based systems engineering frameworks, astrodynamics, or flight dynamics
 Who You Are 
 You can explain orbital mechanics to a program manager and debug a Python script with an engineer in the same afternoon without losing credibility with either
 You approach customer conversations with curiosity, not a pitch deck, asking the right questions to understand what they are actually trying to build and where simulation fits
 You are organized enough to manage multiple complex engagements across time zones, keeping stakeholders aligned and projects moving without constant escalation
 You push back when a solution does not fit the problem, even if it means a harder conversation, because you care more about long-term customer success than short-term wins
 You are a natural mentor, sharing what you know without gatekeeping, and you genuinely enjoy helping others grow their technical and customer-facing skills
 You stay current on aerospace and defense trends, tools, and techniques, not because it is required but because you are genuinely interested in how the field is evolving
 The Team You'll Be Part Of 
 You will join a dynamic, globally distributed team focused on advancing model-based engineering within the defense sector. Our team covers mission engineering topics worldwide, working collaboratively to increase the adoption and impact of Synopsys Digital Mission Engineering software. Together, we drive innovation, share knowledge, and deliver solutions that empower our customers to achieve their missions. 
 Rewards and Benefits 
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

items.jobTitle: Expert - Medium Voltage Power Conversion Systems (m/f/d)
items.jobDescription:
NXT Talent Studio | Empowering Careers. Enabling Organizations.
 Shape the Future of Medium Voltage Power Conversion at a Global R&D Leader
 Do you thrive on the forefront of next-generation power electronics and want to push the boundaries of high-power energy systems? We are seeking an exceptional technical expert for a globally leading technology pioneer and innovator in digital power solutions, located in Nuremberg. Here, you will encounter the resources and impact of an international technology powerhouse combined with the agility, scientific rigor, and collaborative spirit of a world-class research laboratory.
In this role, you are not merely executing standard designs—you act as the senior technical authority steering medium-voltage (MV) research initiatives from initial architecture to physical lab validation. Our client is driving the global green energy transition by designing novel power converters and control systems for high-power Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Data Centers, and Megawatt-scale EV charging infrastructures.
 What You Will Do: Your Mission
 Serve as the Technical Authority: Formulate technical roadmaps and strategic requirements for cutting-edge R&D activities in Medium Voltage Power Conversion Systems.
 Architect Next-Gen Solutions: Lead and execute the research and development of novel MV topologies and converter structures across high-power Solar PV, BESS, Data Center, and EV charging domains.
 Drive Laboratory Validation: Take end-to-end ownership of converter design, testing, verification, and proof-of-concept validation in state-of-the-art R&D laboratories.
 Foster External Research Collaborations: Partner closely with leading universities and research institutes to co-develop advanced converter topologies and control algorithms.
 Build Intellectual Property: Pioneer breakthrough technical concepts and secure them through international patent (IPR) filings.
 Empower the Team: Mentor, guide, and inspire cross-disciplinary R&D engineers across international teams.
 Your Qualifications
 Academic Excellence: Master's degree or PhD in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
 Industry Track Record: Several years of proven experience in medium-voltage, high-power electronics, and prototype/system development within an industrial R&D context.
 Deep Domain Expertise: Profound technical mastery of MV converter topologies, modulation schemes, control algorithms, and Megawatt-scale hardware design.
 Standards & Insulation: Working knowledge of relevant MV standards along with practical insulation coordination experience.
 Innovation & Leadership: Demonstrated track record of leading technological initiatives, driving novel concepts, and mentoring technical teams.
 Working Style: High degree of autonomy, a target-driven "can-do" mindset, and the drive to think outside established boundaries.
 Languages: Professional fluency in written and spoken English; willingness to travel occasionally for conferences and technical forums.
 Bonus (Nice-to-Have)
 Track record of published patents and IPR filings in high-power conversion.
 Practical hands-on expertise in Megawatt-class testing and grid-compliance validation.
 German, Mandarin, or additional language skills.
 The Company Benefits
 Global Innovation Culture: A collaborative, high-tech environment powered by intensive knowledge sharing across an international network of researchers.
 Continuous Growth & Upskilling: Broad spectrum of dedicated training programs, professional certifications, and internal language courses (including German and Mandarin).
 International Environment: A truly diverse, welcoming workplace bringing together top engineering talent from over 40 nations.
 Cutting-Edge Infrastructure: Full access to world-class laboratory facilities, advanced simulation tools, and prototype test benches.
 Competitive Package: Highly attractive compensation, comprehensive corporate benefits, and long-term career perspectives.
 Ready for your next career milestone in Nuremberg? Send us your updated resume. We look forward to connecting with you!
 Equal Opportunity & Diversity
 We and our client believe in the power of diversity and actively foster an inclusive work environment. We welcome all applications—regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or worldview, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity. Your expertise, innovative drive, and passion for engineering excellence are what count.

# Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) für Embedded Hardware + HV Systeme
[BEWERBEN](https://www.isg.com/jobs/applications/applyForJobEntry.jsf;jsessionid=47bf6c8fee28e85b65411e4ce1f6?inseratnummer=112730&refererId=20)
Unser Auftraggeber ist ein international tätiges Familienunternehmen aus Süddeutschland und technologischer Taktgeber im Bereich Hochvoltsysteme für die E-Mobility. Wo andere nur Komponenten liefern, entstehen hier intelligente Gesamtlösungen – von der Leiterplatte zu intelligente Hochvolt-Verteilerboxen, Embedded-Steuergeräte und komplexe Leistungselektronik – Lösungen, die direkt in den Fahrzeugarchitekturen der nächsten Generation zum Einsatz kommen.
Mittelständische Entscheidungswege treffen hier auf anspruchsvolle Automotive-Entwicklung.
Gesucht wird kein reiner Schaltungsentwickler – sondern ein Ingenieur, der Hochvolt versteht und Hardware bis zur Serienreife denkt.
### Ihre Mission – robuste Hardware für reale Belastung
- Sie entwickeln Embedded-Hardware für Automotive-Anwendungen wie Ladeinlets, EVCC oder Power Distribution Units.
- Sie designen Leiterplatten für Hochstromanwendungen – inklusive Dickkupfer- und Dickschicht-Technologie – und wissen, worauf es bei thermischer und elektrischer Belastung ankommt.
- Sie stellen die Einhaltung relevanter Normen sicher (ISO 16750, LV 124, LV 148, ISO 26262), planen und führen Hardwaretests und Validierungen durch und analysieren Fehlerursachen systematisch

 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, adäquate Bezahlung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Firmenfitness mit EGYM Wellpass und vieles mehr

- Sie sind als Teilprojektleiter/-in und Product Owner für die Entwicklung der Software verantwortlich

- Sie erstellen SW-Anforderungen und Moduldesigns
- Desweiteren planen, koordinieren und verfolgen Sie die Entwicklung von SW-Releases für das Projekt in Abstimmung mit den Stakeholdern und den beteiligten Software-Entwicklern

 Initiativbewerbung wissenschaftliche / Hilfskräfte all genders
 Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ( www.fraunhofer.de ) ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.
 Die Fraunhofer-Einrichtung für Wertstoffkreisläufe und Ressourcenstrategie IWKS entwickelt zirkuläre Materialien und materialwissenschaftliche Technologien für eine ultimativ nachhaltige, abfallfreie Kreislaufwirtschaft. In enger Verzahnung mit Hochschulen, anderen Fraunhofer Instituten und Industriepartnern forschen die rund 100 Mitarbeitenden an der Substitution kritischer Rohstoffe durch nachhaltigere Alternativen und erarbeitet Lösungen zur intelligenten Regeneration zukunftsweisender Materialien sowie zu deren energieeffizienter Rückgewinnung als nachhaltige Präkursoren für die Produktion.
 Als Teil der Fraunhofer Gesellschaft ist das Ziel des Fraunhofer IWKS, Forschungserkenntnisse anwendbar zu machen für Industrieunternehmen. Gemeinsam mit seinen Partnern leistet es so einen wertvollen Beitrag zu einer Transformation der Industrie und einem gesunden Planeten. 
 Starte Deinen nächsten Karriereschritt im Team vom IWKS an unseren Standorten in Alzenau/Hanau als:
 Wissenschaftliche / Studentische Hilfskraft mit und ohne Abschlussarbeit - all genders 
 (Pflicht-)Praktikant - all genders 
 Was Du bei uns tust 
 Studierende haben die Möglichkeit, ihre Abschlussarbeit (Bachelor/Master) in einem unserer Forschungsbereiche, der Verwaltung oder innerhalb der Technik anzufertigen und aktiv an aktuellen, anwendungsnahen Projekten mitzuwirken. Dabei können wertvolle Erfahrungen in zukunftsrelevanten Themenfeldern gesammelt werden.
 Forschung: Du interessierst dich für die Entwicklung zirkulärer Materialien und Technologien in der nachhaltigen Kreislaufwirtschaft? In Projektteams arbeitest du mit Hochschulen, anderen Fraunhofer Instituten und Industriepartnern an der ressourcenschonenden Rückgewinnung innovativer Materialien. 
 Magnetwerkstoffe: Die Entwicklung von Recyclingstrategien und -technologien für End-of-Life-Magnete sowie für Produktionsabfällen. 
 Energiematerialien:   Entwicklung von Recyclingverfahren und Konzepten für die Kreislaufwirtschaft von Batterien, Brennstoffzellen, PV-Modulen und E-Motoren. 
 Digitalisierung der Ressourcen:  Management von Stoffströmen zur Verbesserung der Ressourcennutzungseffizienz und zur Anwendung intelligenter Trenn- und Sortiertechnologien sowie Management von Stoffströmen zur Verbesserung der Ressourcennutzungseffizienz und zur Anwendung intelligenter Trenn- und Sortiertechnologien.
 Verwaltung : Du interessierst dich für betriebswirtschaftliche Themen und hast Freude an administrativen Vorgängen sowie am Umgang mit Menschen? Du unterstützt dein Team und externe Partner aktiv mit deinem Wissen und deiner Hilfsbereitschaft, z.B. in deinem Arbeitsumfeld wie Einkauf, Projektcontrolling, Personalabteilung und Buchhaltung. 
 Technik:  Du hast dir bereits theoretisches Wissen im technischen Bereich angeeignet, sei es in der Informationstechnik oder der Haustechnik. Mit deinem technischen Know-How deiner praktischen Herangehensweise unterstützt du unsere Forschungsteams im täglichen Betrieb und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Infrastruktur reibungslos funktioniert.
 Was Du mitbringst 
 Forschung: Eingeschriebener Studierender, vorzugsweise aus den MINT-Studienbereich
 Verwaltung/ Technik: Für Interessierte innerhalb der Verwaltung und Technik/IT:  BWL-Studiengang mit Schwerpunkten wie Personal, Einkauf o.ä. / Ingenieurstudiengang/ IT-Informationstechnik o.ä. Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit im forschungsnahen Bereich mit sowie Interesse an den Themen rund um Nachhaltigkeit, Recycling und neuen Technologien. Du bist vertraut mit den gängigen Office-Anwendungen; Kenntnisse in SAP sind von Vorteil
 Was Du erwarten kannst 
 Eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit sowie ein hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld
 Einblick in eine der weltweit führende Forschungsgesellschaften
 Mitarbeit an innovativen Forschungsprojekten in verschiedenen Themenfeldern in einem interdisziplinären Team
 Erweiterung des theoretischen Studienwissens durch praktische Anwendung
 Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung an die A3/A45 und sehr gute Anbindung an den ÖPNV
 Kostenlose Parkplätze
 Die Anforderungen variieren je nach Geschäftsbereich, Abteilung und spezifischem Aufgabenfeld. Die Aufgaben sind individuell und können von Fachbereich zu Fachbereich stark differenzieren. Bitte teile daher so präzise wie möglich mit, an welchen Fach- oder Forschungsbereichen du besonders interessiert bist. Unsere Vertragslaufzeiten sind zeitlich befristet, abhängig von der Art der Anstellung variieren die Vertragslaufzeiten.  
 Für studentische Hilfstätigkeiten, die möglicherweise mit der Erstellung einer Abschlussarbeit kombiniert werden, beträgt die monatliche Arbeitszeit bis zu 50 Stunden. Die Arbeitszeit für studentische Hilfskräfte kann bis zu 80 Monatsstunden betragen. Bei Praktika liegt die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit bei 39 Stunden.  Die Vergütung für studentische Hilfskräfte orientiert sich an der Gesamtbetriebsvereinbarung zur Anstellung von Hilfskräften.  Bei Praktika richtet sich die Vergütung nach den bundesweit geltenden Richtlinien für Praktikantenvergütungen. 
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.  Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. 
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Inno

items.jobTitle: Multiphysics Power Module Simulation & Digital Engineering
items.jobDescription:
Job Description
 We are seeking a highly innovative and technically strong Senior Engineer to drive the next generation of virtual product development methodologies for advanced power semiconductor packages. This position combines multiphysics simulation, machine learning, digital engineering, and design optimization to accelerate the development of SiC and GaN power modules.
The successful candidate will lead the development of AI-enhanced simulation workflows, surrogate modeling methodologies, digital twins, and automated design environments that enable faster, more reliable, and physics-informed product development. Working across global R&D teams, the candidate will establish novel approaches that combine first-principles engineering models with machine learning and optimization techniques.
 Responsibilities
 Technical Leadership
 Drive the development of simulation-driven design methodologies for power module technologies. 
 Define and implement next-generation virtual product development frameworks. 
 Develop technical roadmaps for AI-assisted engineering and simulation automation. 
 Act as a technical expert for digital engineering initiatives across global development teams. 
 Multiphysics Modeling & Simulation
 Lead electrical, thermal, mechanical, and coupled multiphysics simulations of advanced power modules. 
 Develop and validate simulation methodologies for SiC and GaN package architectures. 
 Support technology development through predictive modeling and virtual prototyping. 
 Correlate simulation results with experimental data and reliability testing. 
 Machine Learning & Digital Engineering
 Develop machine learning models for performance prediction, reliability estimation, and design optimization. 
 Create surrogate models, reduced-order models, and digital twins of power modules. 
 Investigate state-of-the-art AI methodologies
 Design Space Exploration & Optimization
 Lead multi-objective optimization studies covering performance, cost, reliability, manufacturability, and sustainability. 
 Develop automated design synthesis workflows for package architecture exploration. 
 Implement uncertainty quantification and robust design methodologies. 
 Automation & Software Development
 Develop Python-based engineering tools and automated simulation workflows. 
 Interface simulation platforms, databases, and AI frameworks. 
 Contribute to scalable software solutions supporting engineering productivity.
 Qualifications
 Required Qualifications
 M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Computational Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 Minimum 3 years of industrial or advanced research experience in simulation-driven product development. 
 Strong expertise in multiphysics simulation and numerical methods. 
 Experience with one or more simulation platforms like Ansys
 Strong programming skills in Python. 
 Experience with machine learning and data-driven engineering methodologies. 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills in an international environment. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience in:
 Power Electronics Packaging
 SiC and GaN Technologies
 Virtual Product Development
 Digital Twins
 Reliability & Lifetime Prediction
 Record of technical innovation demonstrated through patents, publications, software development, or industrial deployments. 
 About Us
 onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.
 More details about our company benefits can be found here: 
 https://www.onsemi.com/careers/career-benefits
 About The Team
 We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work.

Dein Einstieg bei Bavarian Automotive Technologies
 Willkommen bei Bavarian Automotive Technologies! Wir sind ein multinationales Start-up mit Sitz in München, Friedrichshafen, Wolfsburg und Pristina (Kosovo). Unser Fokus liegt auf nachhaltigen und vernetzen Mobilitätslösungen.
Im Großraum München suchen wir einen Testingenieur (d/w/m), der die Außenleuchten für die Premiumfahrzeuge eines OEM erprobt. Du hast Spaß an einer vielfältigen Herausforderung im Bereich Komfortelektronik? Dann bewirb dich bei uns und trage zur Vielfalt unseres Unternehmens bei!
 Deine Aufgaben werden sein:
 Erstellung von Testspezifikationen und Testfällen für Exterior-Light-Funktionen (z. B. Scheinwerfer, Heckleuchten, Blinker, adaptives Fernlicht, Matrix- und Pixellicht) auf Basis von Lastenheften und Anforderungen
 Durchführung manueller und automatisierter Tests am HiL und im Fahrzeug
 Absicherung der Lichtsteuergeräte und ihrer Vernetzung über CAN, CAN FD, LIN und Automotive Ethernet
 Entwicklung und Pflege der Testautomatisierung, z. B. mit Python, CAPL oder ECU-TEST
 Analyse von Fehlerbildern, Erstellung von Fehlerberichten und Nachverfolgung bis zur Behebung
 Aktive Unterstützung und Zusammenarbeit mit dem Fachbereich von BMW und den Lieferanten
 Das bringst du mit
 Berufserfahrung im Testing von Steuergeräten oder Fahrzeugfunktionen, idealerweise im Bereich Exterior Light
 Sicherer Umgang mit Testwerkzeugen wie CANoe/CANalyzer, dSPACE oder ECU-TEST
 Kenntnisse der gesetzlichen Lichtvorschriften (z. B. UN ECE R48 und R149) von Vorteil
 Kenntnisse in Testmanagement- und Anforderungstools (z. B. Polarion, ALM, DOORS), ISTQB oder ASPICE von Vorteil
 Programmiererfahrung, z. B. in Python oder CAPL
 Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 Das können wir Dir bieten
 Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, ein umfassendes Benefit Paket und Möglichkeiten dich beruflich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
 Smarte Altersvorsorge: wir bieten dir ein hochattraktives Produkt der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und beteiligen uns mit einem Arbeitsgeberzuschuss
 Hybrides Arbeiten: mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und mobilem Arbeiten sorgen wir für persönliche Flexibilität
 Wellpass & JobRad: Durch den arbeitgeberbezuschussten EGYM Wellpass kannst du zahlreiche Sporteinrichtungen nutzen. Unser JobRad ermöglicht dir darüber hinaus das Leasing deines Traumrads für eine nachhaltige Mobilität
 E-Mobility Infrastruktur: ausreichend Parkplätze und die Möglichkeit dein E-Auto oder E-Bike an unseren Ladestationen zu laden sind bei uns vorhanden
 Weiterbildung: weil gut ausgebildete Mitarbeiter unser Schlüssel zum Erfolg sind, bieten wir dir individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
 Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: unsere Zusammenarbeit ist durch wertschätzende Kommunikation, Feedbackkultur, konstruktive Dynamik, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Unternehmenskultur geprägt
 Corporate Benefits: wir bieten allen Mitarbeitenden zusätzliche Benefits in Form von Mitarbeiterrabatten, welche online oder in der Filiale eingelöst werden können
 Socializing & Networking: ob bei Teamevents, der Sommerparty oder Weihnachtsfeier - du hast viele Gelegenheiten dich innerhalb des Unternehmens zu vernetzen
 uvm.
 Über uns
 Wir sind ein multinationales Unternehmen mit herausragendem Know-how in den Bereichen, E-Mobilität, SDV, Infotainment und ADAS. Wir setzen auf lokale Wurzeln mit internationalem Fokus, um als Partner für nachhaltige Technologien die Zukunft mitzugestalten.
Mit mehr als 20 Jahren Erfahrung sind wir ein Partner für Produktentwicklung, Beratung und technische Lösungen. Unsere Ingenieurdienstleistungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Hardware, Software und Tests unterstützen den gesamten Lebenszyklus von NEV-Komponenten und -Systemen.
Wir arbeiten kundenorientiert, denn nur Gemeinsam können wir die besten Lösungen schaffen. Mit unserem Fachwissen, unserer Belegschaft und unseren technischen Ressourcen helfen wir unseren Kunden bei der Umsetzung ihrer Projekte, von der Konzeptphase bis zur Realisierung des Projekts.
Wir würden uns freuen, dich in unserer BAT Familie willkommen zu heißen!

Die ALTEN Consulting Services GmbH bietet mit über 20 Jahren Branchenerfahrung ihren namhaften Kunden aus Industrie und Wirtschaft hochspezialisierte Engineering- und IT-Dienstleistungen zur gemeinsamen Realisierung von branchen- und technologieübergreifenden Lösungen an.
 Kompetenz, Engagement und Leidenschaft verbinden alle unsere Mitarbeiter der ALTEN Consulting Services GmbH.  MAKE IT HAPPEN
 Du möchtest an der Entwicklung moderner Avioniksysteme mitwirken und dabei Hardware, Software und Kommunikationsschnittstellen zu einem zuverlässigen Gesamtsystem verbinden? Dann übernimm Verantwortung in der Entwicklung und Integration von Avionik-Komponenten für den Luftfahrtbereich.
 DU...
 entwickelst und spezifizierst Anforderungen auf Avionik-Equipment-Ebene sowie für Hard- und Softwarekomponenten
 übernimmst die Auswahl, Bewertung und Integration geeigneter Avionik-Komponenten 
 wirkst bei der Konzeption und Auslegung von Prototypen für Avionik-Hardware mit
 entwickelst und integrierst Verbindungssysteme für Luft- und Bodensegment 
 verantwortest die Pflege und Verwaltung der Interface-Datenbank 
 koordinierst und betreust Lieferanten von Avionik-Komponenten
 arbeitest an der technischen Integration von Komponenten und Schnittstellen innerhalb komplexer Avioniksysteme
 BE OUR FORWARD THINKER
 DU...
 hast ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Fahrzeugtechnik, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
 verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung im Bereich Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik 
 bringst grundlegende Kenntnisse in Avionik und elektrischen Systemen mit
 kennst dich mit digitalen Kommunikationsschnittstellen wie CAN, ARINC und seriellen Schnittstellen aus
 hast gute Kenntnisse in MATLAB/Simulink 
 verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office 
 Kenntnisse in SysML/UML, ANSI C oder Polarion sind von Vorteil
 arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und lösungsorientiert
 hast Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und der Entwicklung komplexer technischer Systeme
 YOUR IMPACT
 Du gestaltest die Entwicklung und Integration moderner Avioniksysteme aktiv mit. Dabei verbindest du Anforderungen, Hardware, Software und Kommunikationsschnittstellen und sorgst dafür, dass einzelne Komponenten zu einem zuverlässigen Gesamtsystem werden.
 Dann make it happen!

As a Power Electronics Engineer - Power Converters (m/f/d), you will play a key role in resolving complex technical issues across our global wind turbine fleet. Acting as the interface between Service and Engineering, you will lead root cause investigations, coordinate cross-functional problem-solving activities, and help translate operational learnings into both retrofit solutions and future product improvements. Your work directly contributes to the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of our power converter systems.
 YOUR TASKS 
 Act as 3rd Level Support for complex technical issues related to power converters across the global wind turbine fleet 
 Perform structured and in-depth root cause analyses of converter-related failures and operational incidents to identify sustainable corrective actions 
 Drive the resolution process by collaborating with Service, Electrical Engineering, Testing, and Product Development teams 
 Develop and coordinate technical solutions for hardware and software-related power converter issues 
 Define and validate corrective actions, including retrofit solutions for installed turbines and design improvements for future serial products 
 Support the validation of solutions through testing activities on laboratory test benches and wind turbines 
 Provide expert guidance to Service teams and other stakeholders during the investigation and resolution of critical converter-related topics 
 YOUR PROFILE 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline 
 At least 3 years of professional experience in power electronics, preferably within the wind industry or another industrial environment involving power converter technology 
 Experience with power converters and their application in industrial systems, ideally within renewable energy, grid-connected systems, drives, or comparable technologies 
 Knowledge of troubleshooting methodologies, root cause analysis, and technical problem-solving in complex engineering environments, combined with a solid understanding of power electronic components, converter architectures, testing methods, and validation processes 
 Experience with qualification, homologation, or testing of power electronic and power system components; experience with relevant PDM, PLM (ideally Teamcenter), or ERP tools is an advantage 
 Fluent English language skills; German and/or Spanish are considered an asset 
 Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented working style with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across international, cross-functional teams and stakeholders 
 Your Benefits
 Nordex offers a range of attractive benefits – here’s a selection of what you can look forward to.
 #GreenerFuture : Shape a sustainable future with us – your work makes a real contribution to the environment.
 #Flexibility: Work-life balance is important to us – we offer flexible working hours, various working time models, and up to 8 days of mobile work per month.
 #Mobility: We promote sustainable mobility – we support you with an 80% subsidy for the public transportation ticket (Deutschlandticket) and a €15 employer contribution for bike leasing.
 #CareForTomorrow: With our company pension scheme, you secure a financial advantage for the future – complemented by the option of occupational disability insurance.
 #Health : Your health matters to us – benefit from health days, company sports activities, office yoga, and free support from the pme Family Service.
 #Holiday: We offer you 30 days of vacation per year based on a full-time position, plus December 24th and 31st off.
 #OneCompany : Stronger together– with over 10,000 employees from 95 nations, we promote an international and collegial corporate culture.
 #CorporateBenefits: Saving made easy – enjoy attractive discounts on travel, tech, and much more.
 Some offers may vary by location
 Nordex adheres to a policy of equal employment opportunity. All employment decisions are made without regard to religion, age, sex, color, national origin, handicap, or other protected class and are in full compliance with all federal and state laws.
Severely disabled applicants and applicants of equal status will be given special consideration in the event of equal suitability. The role is generally available on a full-time basis as well as in other flexible working-time models.

 Incubator: Explorative Projects 
 Surface engineering with mass-selected molecular ions 
 Surface engineering with mass-selected molecular ions 
 Molecular ions exhibit a variety of technologically relevant properties. The preparation of thin ionic surface layers is usually performed by deposition from salt solutions. We explore an alternative preparation method by depositing molecular ions from the gas phase. For this purpose, ions are transferred into a vacuum using electrospray. A desired ion is selected using mass spectrometric methods and subsequently gently deposited on a surface while maintaining the molecular integrity. One of our main goals is the preparation of functional surfaces with submonolayer coverages of redox-switchable complex ions for applications in molecular electronics. Furthermore, multilayer deposits of organometallic cations will be generated for electron beam-induced structuring processes, which could serve as novel nanoscale humidity sensors with high sensitivity.
 Research within the joint lab “molecular ion soft-landing” is performed in direct cooperation with the junior research group of Dr. J. Warneke of Leipzig University.
 Soft-landed anions (B12I122−) on HOPG (Highly oriented pyrolytic graphite) surface. (Photo: Fangshun Yang) 3D figure of single soft-landed anions (supramolecular polyoxometalate-cyclodextrin complex) on gold surface, acquired via scanning tunneling microscope (STM). (Photo: Marco Moors) Picture of the Ion-Soft-Landing apparatus (Photo: Fangshun Yang) Expertise 
 Soft-Landing of mass-selected ions with precisely controlled composition, charge state and kinetic energy
 Electron-induced chemistry on surfaces
 ESI mass spectrometry
 Highlights 
 Anion-Anion Chemistry with Mass-Selected Molecular Fragments on Surfaces 
 F. Yang, K. A. Behrend, H. Knorke, M. Rohdenburg, A. Charvat, C. Jenne, B. Abel, J. Warneke
 Angewandte Chemie Communication, First published: 14 September 2021
 https://doi.org/10.1002/anie.202109249 
 While reactions between ions and neutral molecules in the gas phase have been studied extensively, reactions between molecular ions of same polarity remain relatively unexplored. Herein we show that reactions between fragment ions generated in the gas phase and molecular ions of the same polarity are possible by soft-landing of both reagents on surfaces. The reactive [B 12 I 11 ] 1− anion was deposited on a surface layer built up by landing the generally unreactive [B 12 I 12 ] 2− . Ex-situ analysis of the generated material shows that [B 24 I 23 ] 3− was formed. A computational study shows that the product is metastable in the gas phase, but a charge balanced environment of a grounded surface may stabilize the triply charged product, as suggested by model calculations. This opens new opportunities for the generation of highly charged clusters using unconventional building blocks from the gas phase.
 Insights from Adsorption and Electron Modification Studies of Polyoxometalates on Surface for Molecular Memory Applications
 M. Moors, J. Warneke, X. López, C. de Graaf, B. Abel, K. Y. Monakhov
 Acc. Chem. Res. (2021) 54, 17, 3377–3389
 https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.accounts.1c00311 
 This Account highlights recent experimental and theoretical work focusing on the development of polyoxometalates (POMs) as possible active switching units in what may be called “molecule-based memory cells”. Herein, we critically discuss how multiply charged vanadium-containing POMs, which exhibit stable metal–oxo bonds and are characterized by the excellent ability to change their redox states without significant structural distortions of the central polyoxoanion core, can be immobilized best and how they may work optimally at appropriate surfaces. Furthermore, we critically discuss important issues and challenges on the long way toward POM-based nanoelectronics.
 On-Surface Single-Molecule Identification of Mass-Selected Cyclodextrin-Supported Polyoxovanadates for Multistate Resistive-Switching Memory Applications
 F. Yang, M. Moors, D. A. Hoang, S. Schmitz, M. Rohdenburg, H. Knorke, A. Charvat, X. Wang, K. Yu. Monakhov, J. Warneke
 ACS Appl. Nano Mater. 2022
 https://doi.org/10.1021/acsanm.2c03025 
 If someone wants to use negative molecular ions as single-molecule switching and storage units, an intrinsic problem arises: ions usually deposit with their counterions from solution onto surfaces, forming larger aggregates (quasi small salt crumbs). By mass selection of the anions and soft-landing them in vacuum, these counterions can be excluded and the deposition of single molecular storage units is thereby possible. Initially, the method was not very successful because the switchable anions were simply not stable on surfaces without counterions and decomposed under ambient condition. To counteract this, researchers used a trick from so-called host-guest chemistry. A circular sugar molecule wraps itself around the negative ion as a "ring" and protects it. Thus, the molecular storage unit remains stable even on surfaces and can be successfully switched through several redox states. This opens up new avenues for the preparation and addressing of memory units with a control of the adsorption properties at the single molecule level.

items.jobDescription:
**Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied**
**Siemens Mobility** ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitende sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
**Was trägst Du bei?**
Dein Weg führt Dich in das „[Expert House“](http://siemens.com/mobilityexperthouse) von Siemens Mobility, das nationale und internationale Projekte auf dem Gebiet der Bahntechnik durchführt, z.B. bei den neuen Generationen von batterie- oder wassersstoffbetriebenen Zügen.
- Fachlich legst Du Deinen Schwerpunkt auf Inbetriebsetzung, Systemintegration, Gewährleistung und/oder Instandhaltung. - Dabei übernimmst Du die Schnittstellenklärung mit Projektbeteiligten und unterstützt die Projektleitung.- Du führst selbständig Störungsanalysen und Fehlerbehebungen an den Schienenfahrzeugen durch. Hierbei wirst Du durch innovative IT-Systeme unterstützt. Des Weiteren wirkst du bei Kundenabnahmen mit. - Du erhältst eine umfassende Einarbeitung und wirst durch Trainings und Weiterbildungen gezielt gefördert. Wir machen Dich zur Expertin oder zum Experten der Zukunftsbranche Bahn.- Deine Einsatzorte sind insbesondere unsere Eisenbahn-Depots in aller Welt, die Werkstätten unserer Partner oder unser Prüfcenter Wildenrath. - Durch Deine Tätigkeit im Expert House lernst Du verschiedenste Bereiche in unserem Unternehmen kennen. Das eröffnet Dir vielfältige Chancen für Deine Entwicklung – ebenso persönlich wie auch im Hinblick auf Deine Karriere bei Siemens Mobility.
**Was bringst Du mit?**
- Du bist genau der/die Richtige für uns, wenn Du ein Bachelor-Studium in Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik abgeschlossen hast. - Wenn Du schon erste Berufserfahrung in der Instandhaltung/Inbetriebnahme oder im Engineering (z.B. durch eine Werkstudententätigkeit) gesammelt hast, wäre das von Vorteil.- Du liebst es für mehrere Monate zu reisen und bist bereit auch ggf. Schichtdienst an den entsprechenden Einsatzorten zu übernehmen.- Für Deine neue Aufgabe auf internationaler Bühne bringst Du gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit.- Außerdem bist Du im Besitz eines Führerscheins Klasse B.
**Was bieten wir Dir?**
Attraktive Konditionen
Du erhälst ein attraktives Vergütungspaket einschließlich der Leistungen des Tarifvertrages (z.B. Zusatzentgelte und Urlaubsgeld) und weiteren Extras (z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Aktienprogramm).
Vielfalt & Internationalität
Wir sind Weltunternehmer und auf allen fünf Kontinenten aktiv. Wir arbeiten für Kunden in aller Welt in internationalen Projekten. Deshalb legen wir in unseren Teams größten Wert auf Inklusion und fördern Vielfalt in all ihren Dimensionen.
Weiterentwicklung
Wir bieten Dir umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Mit unserem Learning Campus verfügen wir über einen Inhouse-Dienstleister mit einem vielfältigen On- und Offline-Angebot.
Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits findest Du [hier](https://new.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/benefits-was-wir-bieten.html).

About us 
 We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects
 About our technology 
 The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude 
 In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution
 The Role 
 We are seeking a Product Qualification Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will execute product qualification activities, turning qualification plans into robust test setups, reliable bench data, and clear, traceable evidence that supports product release.
 Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Reliability Engineer, Product Engineering team, and external laboratories and OSAT partners to plan and execute qualification testing. You will develop test hardware in collaboration with external partners, coordinate the design of test PCBs and fixtures, select and configure test equipment, and ensure every qualification campaign produces accurate, well-documented, and reproducible results.
 Your core focus will be to transform qualification requirements into practical test solutions, execute high-quality validation campaigns, and deliver the reliable data needed to make confident product qualification and release decisions.
 To join our team, you should be excited to: 
 Run product qualification testing by performing bench and laboratory qualification tests (thermal, electrical, mechanical, and environmental stress tests) in accordance with qualification plans and test matrix, while accurately tracking samples, test conditions, and results.
 Develop test PCBs and fixtures with external partners, work on test boards, adapters, and fixtures, from requirements through review and bring-up.
 Set up and maintain qualification test equipment , including thermal chambers, power supplies, data acquisition systems (DAQ), probe stations, and other laboratory instrumentation, ensuring the lab is always ready to support qualification activities.
 Coordinate qualification campaigns with OSATs and external laboratories by managing schedules, sample logistics, and test execution, while providing on-site or remote test supervision where needed
 Collect, analyze, and document qualification results , producing clear pass/fail assessments, comprehensive test reports, and fully traceable records that contribute to the overall product qualification evidence package.
 Identify and communicate risks early , proactively escalating test failures, equipment limitations, data anomalies, or schedule risks to the Package Reliability Engineer and Quality & Reliability Program Lead to keep qualification activities on track.
 Your Qualifications 
 Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.
 Hands-on product qualification experience with 2–4+ years of experience in hardware bring-up, bench testing, or product qualification test campaigns.
 Experience testing RF and high-speed I/O , including high-speed serial, RF, or optical links using equipment such as vector network analyzers (VNAs), high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, BERTs, and other signal integrity measurement tools. This is a core requirement for the role, as experience limited to low-speed digital or logic circuit testing is not sufficient. Experience with photonics testing is a strong advantage.
 Proficiency with laboratory test equipment , including oscilloscopes, power supplies, thermal chambers, data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and, ideally, RF and high-speed characterization equipment such as VNAs, BERT, and high-bandwidth scopes.
 Experience developing test hardware , working closely with PCB design and fabrication partners to define specs, review designs, and support the bring-up of test boards or fixtures.
 Strong test execution and documentation skills , running test campaigns methodically and writing clean, traceable results.
 Excellent collaboration and coordination skills , with experience working across reliability engineering, product engineering, external laboratories, and OSAT partners to successfully execute qualification activities.
 Thrives in a startup environment , demonstrating initiative, adaptability, and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.
 Our work culture 
 People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters
 Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development
 Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future
 We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward
 We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.
 We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

 Software Engineers at Axle build the core infrastructure for connecting to distributed energy devices, orchestrating them, and allowing them to participate in electricity markets.

 Software engineering at Axle looks like

Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.
 We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.
 We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.
 What is your Day to Day Mission: 
 Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.
 Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud.
 Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.
 Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.
 Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.
 Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.
 Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.
 What you bring to the team: 
 Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code.
 A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.
 The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks.
 Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce.
 Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target environment.
 Experience with distributed, real-time or performance-critical systems.
 A solid testing mindset, from unit tests to hardware-in-the-loop or simulation.
 Clear communication and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.

 Experience with robotics, autonomy or sensor integration.
 Experience setting up agent-based workflows, such as parallel agents, automated test and review loops or custom tooling around coding agents.
 Embedded or real-time experience (RTOS, bare metal, firmware).

We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

 Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger. 
 The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. 
 We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust .   
 You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems. 
 Your overall responsibilities include 
 Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code 
 Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop; 
 Taking ownership from discovery to post-production; 
 Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis; 
 Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices 
 Who we are looking for 
 In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters. 
 Additionally, you tick the following boxes: 
 You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience. 
 You have previous experience in the payments domain. 
 You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment. 
 You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases. 
 You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka. 
 You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build. 
 You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket. 
 You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement. 
 You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission. 
 Nice to have 
 Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain. 
 Join us in building a better future 
 We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place. 
 Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry! 
 As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure. 
 Our benefits package includes: 
 Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation. 
 Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned). 
 A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities. 
 In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use. 
 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you. 
 Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree. 
 Understanding women's health is beneficial for all of us, fostering empathy, improving communication, and creating a more inclusive workplace. That's why we teamed up with Flouria, providing you with quick access to a broad range of women's health professionals. 
 Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations. 
 Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees. 
 Other perks include flexible working hours, full travel compensation and the working gear of your choice. 
 Interested in making an impact? 
 We would love to have a conversation with you! 
 Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your motivation letter why you’re excited about joining Fastned. 
 Here’s the next steps of the hiring process: 
 Screening call with Recruiter 
 Codility assignment and technical interview with our Engineers 
 Culture-fit conversation with the team 
 Closing Coffee Chat with our Head of Engineering / Director of Product & Engineering 
Then, it’s time to welcome you on board to Fastned! 
 Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. 
 If you have questions or need further information regarding your application, please contact our recruitment team via fastned.nl

Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.
 We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.
 We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.
 What is your Day to Day Mission: 
 Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.
 Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud.
 Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.
 Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.
 Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.
 Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.
 Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.
 What you bring to the team: 
 Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code.
 A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.
 The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks.
 Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce.
 Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target environment.
 Experience with distributed, real-time or performance-critical systems.
 A solid testing mindset, from unit tests to hardware-in-the-loop or simulation.
 Clear communication and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.
 Nice to have 
 Experience with robotics, autonomy or sensor integration.
 Experience setting up agent-based workflows, such as parallel agents, automated test and review loops or custom tooling around coding agents.
 Embedded or real-time experience (RTOS, bare metal, firmware).
 Familiarity with ROS 2 or simulation frameworks.
 Knowledge of communication protocols and low-latency data transport.
 Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.
 Our benefits: 
 Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.
 Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.
 Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.
 Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.
 Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.
 Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.
 Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.
 Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.
 Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.
 About us: 
 Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.
 Our commitment: 
 We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.
 At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

 The role involves creating operator interfaces (HMI), developing underlying control logic, performing testing and simulations, and supporting industrial communication interfaces. 
 Your Responsibilities
