items.jobDescription:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Global Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day. 
 We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our London office as part of a Global DoorDash Engineering team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). 
 Our New Verticals team exists to grow monthly active usage outside of restaurant ordering — groceries, retail, and everything in between. That means turning someone who only orders restaurant food into someone who also uses the app for a grocery run, and turning dormant users into active ones. You'll work on the surfaces that make that happen: the homepage, vertical landing pages, and the notifications that bring people back. This role sits closer to the personalisation and ranking side of that mission, working alongside colleagues across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Build and improve ranking models for vertical landing pages (grocery, retail), deciding what a user sees first when they land on a store page 
 Design models that blend new-vertical content into a homepage built around restaurant ordering, without disrupting the core experience 
 Build personalisation models that translate a user's existing behaviour into relevant recommendations for verticals they haven't tried yet 
 Contribute to notification targeting — who gets notified, with what message, and when, to drive adoption of new verticals 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 
 Minimum 3+ years of experience as an ML Engineer or Data Scientist, with a proven ability to write high-quality production code in Python 
 Experience with end-to-end model productionisation 
 A bias to simplicity, where you care most about achieving impact 
 Background in personalisation, ranking, or recommender systems; exposure to causal inference or uplift modelling is a genuine plus but not expected 
 Why Join Us? 
 At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 
 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale 
 Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 
 🌱 See your impact, fast 
 Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 
 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 
 🌎 A culture built for builders 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 
 💰 Share in the success you help create 
 Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. 
 ➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog. 
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

About hyperexponential (hx)
 At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
 Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
 Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
 What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
 What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
 If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
 About the Platform team
 Platform at hx builds the foundation that enables engineering teams to ship secure, scalable applications at velocity. We're evolving towards an AI-first platform where self-service infrastructure, intelligent automation, and reusable components compound developer productivity and operational excellence. This isn't about maintaining the status quo; we're reimagining how modern software delivery works.
 As the Staff Platform Engineer , you will own the technical direction of this evolution. You will define the architecture and engineering standards that others build to, drive coherence across teams, and ensure the platform strategy is aligned to long-term business outcomes. You will shape how AI-first, self-service infrastructure is done at scale, not just by delivering capabilities yourself, but by creating the conditions for engineering teams across the organisation to move faster, more safely, and more autonomously.
 Check out our Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining! 
 What you'll be doing
 Establish a coherent 12–18 month technical direction for the platform, with clearly articulated trade-offs, milestones, and alignment across engineering leadership. The roadmap is understood, trusted, and actively referenced by stakeholders.
 Platform capabilities are adopted broadly across engineering, not because teams are told to use them, but because they are well-designed, well-documented, and genuinely reduce friction. Measurable reduction in Platform as a bottleneck for common provisioning and deployment tasks.
 Define the architectural patterns and standards that enable autonomous and AI-augmented workflows across the organisation. Other engineers can build AI-native capabilities without requiring Platform's direct involvement in every initiative.
 Platform defined standards for security, reliability, and operational excellence are embedded into how all teams build not enforced through gatekeeping, but adopted because they are the path of least resistance. Measurable reduction in misconfiguration, security exceptions, and operational incidents across the estate.
 Senior engineers are visibly stronger for having worked alongside you. The team develops better instincts for architecture, trade-offs, and platform thinking. You are sought out as a technical authority.
 What you'll need to have done
 Defined the architecture, standards, and patterns for the platform domain over a multi-quarter horizon. Makes high-judgement calls on foundational trade-offs such as build vs buy, depth vs breadth, short-term pragmatism vs long-term coherence and brings the organisation along on those decisions.aa
 Navigating disagreement across senior engineers, architects, and stakeholders to reach durable technical decisions. Comfortable holding a position under pressure, updating it when presented with better evidence, and ensuring decisions stick once made.a
 Accountability for outcomes that span multiple teams and that they do not personally deliver. Designs systems, standards, and enablement approaches that multiply the effectiveness of the engineers araound them, rather than being the primary hands-on contributor to every initiative.
 Defined how AI and automation are embedded into the platform at an architectural level not just experimenting with tools, but establishing patterns that make AI-augmented workflows the default for engineering teams across the organisation.
 Understanding of the adoption dynamics, internal customer needs, and the systemic barriers to self-service. Shapes the platform roadmap based on feedback, usage data, and a clear-eyed view of where friction exists and ensures the platform earns its adoption rather than mandating it.
 Identified architectural, security, and operational risks before they become incidents. Influences how the broader engineering organisation thinks about reliability, security posture, and cost efficiency not just within Platform's direct remit.
 Connecting platform decisions to business outcomes clearly and credibly. Can represent the platform strategy to senior leadership, translate engineering constraints into business language, and use commercial context to sharpen technical priorities.aa
 Actively developing senior engineers through technical challenge, honest feedback, and deliberate exposure to harder problems. Recognised as someone who raises the capability of the team, not just the quality of the code. Models the engineering culture the organisation is trying to build.
 You're unlikely to thrive here if
 You prefer executing predefined tasks over taking ownership of ambiguous problems that require exploration, experimentation, and iteration to solve
 You view platform engineering as building infrastructure in isolation rather than treating it as a product with internal customers whose adoption and satisfaction drive success
 You're uncomfortable with rapid change and continuous improvement, preferring stability and established patterns over evolving practices based on data and feedback
 If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.
 Compensation
 At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.
 Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.
 Benefits
 £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.
 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).
 Company pension scheme via Penfold.
 Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life .
 Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.
 Private healthcare insurance through AXA.
 Income protection and Life Insurance.
 Cycle to Work Scheme.
 Additional perks
 Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).
 Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.
 Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry .
 Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.
 Interview process
 Initial call with our Talent team
 Hiring Manager Interview
 Technical Assessment & follow-up interview
 Values Interview
 Meet the CEO
 We offer!
 Our commitment to Diversity
 hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.
 Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.
 If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.
 Next steps
 If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.
 For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Make your business fly
 Engineering, test and materials solutions for aero engines, gas turbines and their components
 MTU provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art solutions in engineering, design and analytics, materials, research and testing, validation and certification, production and maintenance as part of its engineering and production services. We deliver fully integrated solutions from program management all the way through to the final product – including the highest level of quality control. We manage entire programs and are able to implement all processes required for the manufacturing of engine materials, parts, components and gas turbines for use in a variety of fields. These include industrial applications such as power, energy, oil and gas, as well as automotive and manufacturing industries, and of course, aviation.
 Product development, optimization and service support 
 Do you need help developing a new technical application or optimizing an existing product? Look no further! Our engineers are committed to meeting your specific requirements and upholding industry standards. They have unique experience and expertise in the fields of design, validation, manufacturing and maintenance and are greatly experienced in adapting MTU’s aviation technology to other industries.
Our solutions are based on MTU’s cutting edge technology in the aviation sphere and adapted to your purpose. We ensure maximum efficiency, performance, robustness and safety. In doing so, we save on any additional development costs that might otherwise be incurred. Our solutions are precise, flexible, durable, designed to cost, delivered on time and customized to your particular specification and usage. 
 Read more
 Product research, test and validation 
 MTU provides a whole bandwidth of test and validation capabilities for engine parts, modules and components right up to entire engines. Rely on us for excellent quality support, preparation, execution and analysis. 
Our experts have access to a number of qualified test facilities to provide you with solutions that fully suit your requirements. 
Generally speaking, our services include test vehicle design and production, the design and provision of instrumentation, measurement technology – for instance contact-free tip clearance measurement (BSSM), test facility software and operational support.

 Materials engineering
 When developing or optimizing a product, materials testing – such as specimen fatigue testing or failure and damage analysis – is an important part of the process. Computational Materials Engineering provides cost and time efficient computer-aided material and process optimization. We pool our extensive knowledge from all our different fields of expertise to create fully integrated solutions. Our products and services meet your expectations, and the required standards of the respective industry.
 Read more
 Engine and aviation electronics 
 MTU’s electronic department encompasses the complete process chain for the development and validation of safety-critical electronics. It designs and manufactures hardware devices and the corresponding software. And it performs all systems integration and validation work including qualification or certification.

 Institut für Software & Systems Engineering
 Das Institut für Software & Systems Engineering ( ISSE ) ist eine wissenschaftliche Einrichtung der Fakultät für Angewandte Informatik an der Universität Augsburg und wird von Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Reif geleitet. Das Institut betreibt sowohl Grundlagen- als auch angewandte Forschung mit den Schwerpunkten:
 Software Engineering
 Robotik und Automation
 Selbstorganisierende und adaptive Systeme
 Künstliche Intelligenz
 Safety und Security
 Formale Methoden
 Das ISSE ist für die  Softwaretechnik-Ausbildung in den Informatik- und informatiknahen Studiengängen der Fakulät zuständig. Das ISSE leitet den Elitestudiengang Software Engineering, in dem die Universität Augsburg, die Technische Universität München und die LMU München ihre Software-Kompetenzen im Elitenetzwerk Bayern bündeln. Das ISSE leitet auch das Innovationslabor ‘Kollaborative Robotik’ des Zentrums Digitalisierung Bayern (ZD.B). Das Institut ist Partner im Technologietransfer der Universität Augsburg in den Großprojekten WIR (Innovative Hochschule) und PiA (Gründungsförderung EXIST).
 Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Reif, Institutsleiter
 Aktuelles

 Zwei wissenschaftliche Paper auf der ISoLA 2026 vorgestellt
 Wir freuen uns, bekannt geben zu dürfen, dass zwei wissenschaftliche Paper unseres Teams auf der ISoLA 2026 vorgestellt wurden.

 Mit großer Freude dürfen wir bekannt geben, dass vier wissenschaftliche Paper unseres Teams auf der ACSOS 2026 in Venedig präsentiert wurden.

 Gastvortrag "The Upstream Shift: How AI Changes Organisations That Build Software"
 Am 12.11.2026 hält Dr. Jan-Philipp Steghöfer von XITASO ab 16:00 Uhr einen Gastvortrag in der Ringvorlesung des Elitestudiengangs Software Engineering. Der Vortrag findet in Raum 1055N statt und hat den Titel "The Upstream Shift: How AI Changes Organisations That Build Software". Zum Vortrag sind alle herzlich eingeladen.
 Weiterlesen
 Weitere aktuelle Meldungen 
 19. Juni 2023
 ISSE bei Eröffnung des KI-Erlebnisraums "Halle 43"
 Am 19.06.2023 war das ISSE an der feierlichen Eröffnung des KI-Erlebnisraums "Halle 43" des KI-Produktionsnetzwerks Augsburg beteiligt. 
Mit zwei Demonstratoren zum Thema "Künstliche Intelligenz in der Industrie", der Präsentation 2er Versuchsanlagen und einem Vortrag haben Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Reif und sein Team Einblicke in die aktuelle Forschung zu einem der brennendsten Themen der aktuellen Tage gegeben.
 13. Dezember 2022
 Open Research Lab 2022
 Am Dienstag, den 20. Dezember 2022, ab 14:00 Uhr lädt der Lehrstuhl für Softwaretechnik des Instituts für Software & System Engineering ein. Zwischen 14:00 Uhr und 16.00 Uhr präsentieren im Foyer des Informatikgebäudes vor dem Hörsaal 2045 N die Forschungsgruppen ihre aktuellen Ergebnisse und bieten die Möglichkeit, diese bei verschiedenen Demonstrationen zu erleben. 
Das Open Research Lab bietet die Gelegenheit, mehr über die Forschung des Lehrstuhls in den Bereichen „Software & Systems Engineering“, „Safety und Security“, „Formale Methoden“, „Selbstorganisierende Systeme“, „Robotik und Automation“ und „Methoden der Künstlichen Intelligenz“ zu erfahren. 
Interessierte Studenten haben außerdem die Möglichkeit, sich über Praxis- und Forschungsmodule, Projektmodule oder Abschlussarbeiten sowie studentische Mitarbeit am Lehrstuhl zu informieren. 
Wir freuen uns auf zahlreiche Besucher und einen angeregten Austausch bei Punsch und Plätzchen!
 28. Juni 2019
 Exkursion zum DLR für Studierende der Ingenieursinformatik
 Was machen eigentlich die Wissenschaftler beim Deutschen Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt (DLR)? Was haben die Trolleys der Flugbegleiter mit dem Kerosinverbrauch eines Flugzeugs zu tun? Und wie kann Automatisierung mit sehr kleinen Stückzahlen und dafür umso größeren Bauteilen aussehen? Die Antworten auf diese und viele weitere Fragen bekam die Studierenden der Ingenieursinformatik, die an der Exkursion zum DLR in Augsburg am 28.06. teilnahmen. Die Studierenden bekamen dort einen Überblick über die verschie-denen Aufgaben- und Tätigkeitsbereiche des DLR. Darüber hinaus konnten sie die Forschungs- und Produktionsanlagen besichtigen und sich so selbst ein Bild über die Herausforderungen der Faserverbundfertigung und Automatisierung in der Luft- und Raumfahrt machen. In der anschließenden Diskussion wurden die offen gebliebenen Fragen der Studierenden beantwortet.
 22. Februar 2019
 Flugrobotik, Augmented Reality und selbstlernende Maschinen in der CFK-Produktion: Technologie und Innovation in Augsburg
 Robert Brannekämper, Vorsitzender des Ausschusses für Wissenschaft und Kunst im bayerischen Landtag, machte sich am Freitag, 22.02.2019, gemeinsam mit einer Delegation der Universitätsleitung ein Bild von aktuellen Forschungsaktivitäten im Bereich Technologie und Innovation. Das Institut für Software & Systems Engineering gewährte hierzu einen Einblick hinter seine Kulissen. Neben Ensembles von Quadrocoptern, die einfach per "Zauberstab" gesteuert werden, um beispielsweise in geographischen Messungen zum Einsatz zu kommen, standen Themen aus der Industrie 4.0 im Vordergrund. Herr Brannekämper konnte den fertigen Aufbau einer Produktionszelle kooperierender Roboter vorab mittels Techniken der Augmented Reality inspizieren und erhielt einen Einblick in softwaretechnische Maßnahmen, die eine CFK-Produktionsanlage mittels künstlicher Intelligenz in eine selbstlernende Maschine verwandeln.

items.jobTitle: Research and Development Engineer in Formal Methods - 12 months contract
items.jobDescription:
Who we are ? 
 Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.
 The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.
 Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders.
 The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios.
 A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines.
 Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in experimental evaluations using cybersecurity benchmarks and industrial use cases, contributing to the development of a practical verification tool.
 Your main responsibilities will include : 
 Carry out R&D work in formal methods and cybersecurity verification
 Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom
 The candidate must have a sound knowledge of formal methods, transition systems, verification algorithms and software development. They must be able to design, test and document research software in a collaborative environment, and have a good command of English.
 Skills in temporal or strategic logic, model checking, symbolic methods, SAT/SMT and multi-agent systems would be an advantage. Experience in cybersecurity, attack graphs, Python/C++ programming, Docker or distributed systems would also be an asset.
 The candidate must demonstrate good team spirit, rigour, organisational skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as strong communication and technical writing skills.
 Education and experience : Master’s degree (Bac+5) or equivalent; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+4) with at least 4 years’ experience; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+3) with 6 years’ experience; or a two-year higher education qualification (Bac+2) with 10 years’ professional experience.
 Why join us? 
You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from :
 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT)

 Good to know: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector

 Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. Please note: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector.

Job type : 12 months contract

 Interpret and execute tasks based on blueprints, work orders, and written or verbal instructions.

 Ensure compliance with quality standards while maintaining a clean, safe, and organized work environment.

items.jobDescription:
This PhD project offers you a unique opportunity to pioneer a novel protein assay for our innovative Vivalytic point-of-care platform. Here, you will not only help shape the next generation of medical technologies but also make a direct contribution to improving patient care.
 You will begin your work with an in-depth analysis of the current state of research and lay the strategic foundation for the project by comprehensively researching and evaluating diverse assay technologies, from innovative recognition molecules to advanced coupling and detection strategies.
 As the core of your dissertation, you will practically implement these concepts by developing, building, optimizing, and validating a complete, automated assay workflow on our microfluidic system, mastering the interplay of biochemistry, surface chemistry, and system integration.
 Furthermore, you will actively collaborate with our highly interdisciplinary team throughout the entire project and regularly present your research findings to internal stakeholders.
Education: excellent master's degree (or equivalent) in Technical Biology, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related life sciences field
 Experience and Know-how:  a broad theoretical background and practical experience in biochemistry and molecular biology with a strong focus on protein biochemistry and immunoassays (e.g., ELISA); ideally, expertise in antibody (mimetic) engineering, microfluidic/lab-on-a-chip systems, and related protein coupling techniques
 Personality and Working Practice: you are able to combine analytical thinking with creative solution approaches while proceeding in a structured, proactive, and hands-on manner; you bring a high degree of independence and personal drive, but also enjoy working collaboratively and with an open mind in a team
 Enthusiasm:  you are driven by scientific curiosity and have the ambition to solve complex challenges; you enjoy working with experts from various disciplines and want to help shape innovative, practice-relevant technologies.
 Languages:  very good written and spoken German and English skills

 Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!
 Your Role: Advisor, Manufacturing Engineering
 Elanco Animal Health is seeking an experienced Senior CQV Engineer for our Central Engineering team to lead and execute validation lifecycle activities across bioprocessing equipment, clean utilities, cleanrooms, and facility systems in compliance with global standards, particularly EU GMP. Serving as a technical SME during capital projects, operational changes, and regulatory inspections, the role requires deep expertise in upstream and downstream bioprocesses, utility qualification, and hands-on troubleshooting.
 Your Responsibilities:
 CQV Lifecycle Leadership: Author, review, and execute key validation deliverables (VMPs, URS, DQ, FAT/SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ) using ISPE risk-based verification approaches in full compliance with EU GMP (Annex 1 & 15) and FDA 21 CFR Part 211.
 Audit & Inspection Readiness: Serve as the on-site technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) during internal quality audits and external regulatory agency inspections.
 Bioprocess & Thermal Equipment Qualification: Lead the qualification and validation of critical upstream and downstream bioprocessing equipment, facility systems, and CIP/SIP cycles, ensuring alignment between CPPs and CQAs.
 Critical Utilities & Root-Cause Troubleshooting: Oversee CQV and monitoring for critical utility systems (WFI, PW, Clean Steam, Process Gases), leading technical root-cause investigations for excursions such as bioburden, microbial limits, and TOC spikes.
 Cleanroom & Environmental Mapping: Direct cleanroom classification (Grade A–D / ISO) and airflow smoke studies, while managing large-scale thermal mapping for cold rooms, freezers, incubators, and warehouses under static and loaded conditions.
 What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, or a related technical discipline.
 Experience: 8+ years of direct CQV or validation engineering experience within the biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industry.
 What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):
 Strong command of risk-based verification approaches such as ISPE Baseline Guide volume 5.
 Hands-on qualification experience with bioreactors, fermenters, single-use technologies, and autoclaves, with demonstrated success in scaling and troubleshooting cell culture or microbial systems.
 Proven diagnostic and root-cause troubleshooting capability resolving bioburden excursions and TOC spikes in WFI/PW distribution networks.
 Proficiency in environmental tracking and thermal validation hardware/software platforms.
 Additional Information:
 Travel: Ability and willingness to travel 0-30% to support various manufacturing sites and vendor locations.
 Location: This role is based at our manufacturing location in Kiel, Germany.

 From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.
 We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack to join our London team (hybrid, 3 days from the office) . In this role, you’ll help us define technical solutions for critical business problems and lead the technical direction for complex, high-scale systems.
 Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 You’ll be joining a high-impact engineering group focused on solving unstructured and ambiguous challenges. You will act as a technical authority, aligning non-adjacent teams to deliver results that move the needle for the entire organisation.

 Drive Technical Excellence: Act as a subject matter expert, providing high-level reviews and technical advice across multiple teams.

 Lead Strategic Direction: Influence the long-term technical roadmap and manage project timelines, risks, and sustainable delivery paces.
 Mentor & Coach: Support the growth of engineers across all levels and partner with up-and-coming leaders to scale our engineering culture.

 Significant experience building web-based applications in a modern stack; we use Go, Ruby, Python, and Scala, and we’re looking for someone keen to work across them.
 Proven ability to design and operate web architecture at scale , specifically with systems handling significant request volumes.
 Demonstrated ownership of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and experience with "NoSQL" backends such as Redis, DynamoDB, or Elasticsearch.

items.jobTitle: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence - 12 months contract
items.jobDescription:
Who we are ? 
 Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.
 The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.
 Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.
 The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.
 A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.
 Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.
 Your main responsibilities will include : 
 Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verification
 Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom
 The candidate must have a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, Python programming, data processing and analysis, and software engineering. They must also be fluent in English and able to develop, train, evaluate, test and document AI components within a collaborative environment.
 Experience in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP/LLM), graph learning, learning-guided search or the deployment of machine learning models would be an advantage. An interest in formal verification, cybersecurity, trustworthy AI, Docker and teaching activities would also be appreciated.
 The role also requires strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as a good team spirit. The candidate must be able to communicate clearly, explain technical concepts in layman’s terms, draft documentation and contribute to teaching activities.
 Required qualifications and experience : the candidate must hold a five-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+5) or equivalent. Applications from candidates with a four-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+4) and at least four years’ professional experience, a three-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+3) and at least six years’ experience, or a two-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+2) and at least ten years’ experience will also be considered.
 Why join us? 
You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from :
 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT)
 flexible working hours (depending on department activity)
 telecommuting 1 to 3 days/week possible
 75% public transport pass reimbursement
 Proximity to numerous sports facilities, concierge service, underground parking, in-house catering, etc.
 Good to know: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector
 Remuneration details: 
 Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. Please note: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector.
 Other information : 
Application deadline: 03/12/2026 
Job type : 12 months contract

Relier les ressources de l'entreprise, sa santé financière et l'excellence opérationnelle.

 Kafka

Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

About Agent F 
 Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.
 Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.
 We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.
 About the role 
 You will sit exactly where sales, customer success and engineering meet. When a larger customer signs, you make sure they get precisely the product they need, and that it goes live. You understand their finance and operations setup, configure and extend Agent F for it, drive the data migration and the integrations, run the project to go-live and stay until the expansion works.
 This is operational work inside customer projects. You will be the technical counterpart for the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams, the person who knows what was promised and what is possible, and the one who brings back to engineering (as clear, prioritised requirements) whatever cannot be solved on site. On key accounts the CEO is in the room and the whole team pulls through together.
 Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means time to live and the ARR of the accounts you bring live.
 What you will build and own 
 Implementation projects. Own scope, plan and delivery from kick-off to verified go-live for your accounts: stakeholders, timeline, risks, decisions.
 Migration and integration. Map the customer’s data, run the imports, reconcile totals against the source and connect Agent F to the systems the customer keeps. Verify the result with the customer before go-live.
 Configuration and extension. Workflows, rules, automations and custom logic on the platform, set up for the customer’s way of working.
 Customer-facing technical lead. Run the technical workstreams with the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams; document decisions and keep everyone informed.
 Product feedback. Turn what customers need into specified, prioritised requirements for engineering; validate delivered features with the customer.
 Expansion readiness. Identify and prepare the next step in each account (the next entity, module or process) together with the account owner.
 FDE economics. Track the hours you deliver per account against what was sold and keep delivery inside the agreed effort.
 For example, a corporate subsidiary signs with a go-live date tied to its next month-end. You would scope the migration, map and import the history, reconcile it with the customer’s controller, configure the approval workflows, connect the bank feed, and run the first close with them (inside the SLA) while logging the two product gaps you found as clear requirements for engineering.
 What you bring 
 You have five or more years in technical implementation, solutions consulting or IT project management for business software (ERP, accounting, finance or operations systems) with real customer projects behind you. You are hands-on with data, mappings, configuration and integrations and comfortable reconciling a migration yourself. You do not need to be a software engineer.
 You can walk us through an implementation you ran: what the customer needed, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you would do differently. You are calm with customers, precise with engineers and stubborn about go-live.
 Core experience 
 Implementation or technical project management of ERP, accounting, finance or operations software with corporate or Mittelstand customers.
 Data migration: mapping, import, reconciliation against the source, validation with the customer.
 Configuration of business software: workflows, rules, permissions, integrations.
 Working with finance teams: understanding the chart of accounts, closing processes and what has to reconcile.
 Running projects with multiple stakeholders: plan, risks, decisions, communication.
 Writing clear requirements for engineers and validating what they deliver.
 German and English; daily use of AI tools in project and data work.
 Useful additional experience 
 Experience with SQL, scripting or low-code tools; integrations with banking, payroll or procurement systems; month-end and year-end close from the inside; consulting or customer-success experience with SaaS products.
 What early progress could look like 
 In your first months, you would take over an onboarding in progress, bring it live inside the SLA and document the path. You would then own your next accounts from kick-off, build the migration and configuration playbook with engineering and hand the first clear requirements into the roadmap.
 We would look for customers live on time and reconciled, fewer issues after go-live, requirements that ship, and hours delivered inside what was sold.
 Operational excellence and customer commitments 
 You take pride in customers who are live and whose numbers reconcile. When a go-live blocker, a failed migration or a month-end issue puts a customer deadline at risk, you take ownership, contain the impact, work with engineering on the fix and verify the result with the customer before treating it as resolved.
 Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an onboarding commitment or a financial deadline is at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed coverage. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover.
 How you will work 
 This is a founding role in a small team. You report to the CEO and work daily with the Growth & Sales Managers who own the accounts, with the Head of Sales on what was sold, and with the engineering team on what the product can do. You will use AI tools in project, data and documentation work and remain responsible for the result.
 Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.
 The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customer sites is part of the role. German is required.
 Start a conversation 
 Share an implementation you ran. Tell us what the customer needed, how you handled the migration and the configuration, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you learned. A short written case or a walkthrough is enough.

items.jobTitle: VP of Product & Engineering - Back of House
items.jobDescription:
Help make the world more hospitable 
 The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.
 You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.
 If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.
 About the role 
 Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
 This role owns Product and Engineering for Back of House, one of the most complex, multi-service domains on the Mews platform. Back of House covers the operational core that hotel teams rely on every day, and it needs someone who can set the product direction and run the engineering behind it, together. That combined mandate, product and engineering under one person at VP level, is rare, and the scale of hospitality technology right now makes it worth doing well.
 You'll own the full domain: strategy, roadmap, and the engineering org that builds it, working closely and collaboratively with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones, and reporting into senior leadership. This isn't a narrow platform mandate. It spans product and engineering together, with the scope to make real calls on both, and the trust to run it as one connected domain.
 Back of House software has to stay reliable at all times and keep improving, without ever pausing customer delivery to get there. The next phase of this role is about applying AI directly to the systems that support hotel teams, not just internal tooling, at a scale most engineering leaders never get to work at.
 What You Would Do 
 Own product and engineering strategy for Back of House end to end, across a genuinely multi-service architecture.
 Run globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones, building the structures that let them ship together.
 Build out a management team and develop senior ICs, growing a culture that holds up at scale.
 Improve reliability, performance and technical debt as ongoing disciplines, without stopping delivery to do it.
 Decide where AI genuinely belongs in the Back of House product, and ship AI-driven improvements that change how hotel teams work day to day.
 AI Fluency Level 4: in this role that means going beyond using AI to move faster yourself. You'll decide where AI belongs in the Back of House product, understand the underlying models and infrastructure well enough to make real engineering calls about them, and have already shipped something where AI was a core part of the product, not a feature added on afterwards.
 For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence. 
 What You Would Bring 
 Combined Product and Engineering ownership at VP level, with clear, end-to-end ownership of a complex, multi-service product domain.
 A track record running globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.
 Experience operating inside a scaling SaaS business, ideally Series C through pre-IPO or recently public, as an operator rather than an adviser.
 Effective people leadership: managing managers, developing senior ICs, and building healthy team cultures at scale, plus a track record of improving reliability, performance and technical debt without stopping delivery.
 AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped AI as a genuine part of a product, not just used it to speed up your own workflow.
 Nice To Have  
 Hands-on experience in hospitality technology: PMS, POS, channel management, revenue management, or closely adjacent systems.
 Travel tech experience (airlines, GDS, travel management companies), or comparable operationally critical, high-availability B2B platforms.
 Founder or early-stage builder experience, having built products from zero to scale.

 Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.
 This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.
 If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.
 What’s in it for you? 
 Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.
 Global benefits 
 No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:
 Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
 Participation in our company share program
 Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
 An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
 Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
 A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
 Relocation options, available after one year
 Flexible, hybrid working options
 A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
 Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working
 Local benefits 
 You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.
 Life at Mews 
 We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.
 We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.
 A few things that define how we work:
 High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
 Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
 We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
 AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.
 If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.
 We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.
 One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.
 If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen
 Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.
 THE TEAM
 • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation
 Millions of parcels, thousands of couriers, and routing, pricing and scheduling decisions needed in real time and under uncertainty. Relay's last mile is a growing optimisation problem that never sits still.
 Relay's in-house solver has carried the business through more than 100x growth, built by a team of Operational Research Scientists who designed the decision architecture the network runs on. You'll join them and take it further.
 Optimisation Highlights
 An in-house solver, built and owned by our own Operational Research team, running live at scale.
 Routing, pricing and scheduling decisions made in real time and under uncertainty.
 ML and recommender intelligence integrated into the decision models.
 A flexible network: pitstops can change, warehouse automation can be reconfigured, and new processes roll out overnight.
 The Opportunity
 As a Quantitative Researcher at Relay, you'll:
 Lead optimisation for Relay's last mile, making the best routing, pricing and scheduling decisions for couriers and the wider network.
 Model and optimise the decisions that define our last-mile delivery network and marketplace.
 Develop our solvers and algorithms so they perform live, and at scale.
 Partner with other Scientists to unite ML and recommender systems with Operational Research.
 Raise the standard for Operational Research at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community.
 We're looking for candidates who…
 Bring deep expertise in operational research, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.
 Come from operational research or industrial engineering, or from an advanced quantitative discipline, including trading, that has branched into optimisation.
 Have built optimisation systems or ML models that run in production, and owned the outcome.
 Are energised by large, messy problems, and know how to bring structure to them.
 Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.
 Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. 
 Who Thrives at Relay? 
 Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
 Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
 All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
 People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
 Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.
If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.
 Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

**Ihre Karriere im Software-Testing.**
Entfalten Sie Ihr Potenzial als Validierungsingenieur (w/m/d): Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING werden Sie zur Schlüsselfigur in der Welt der Medizintechnik. Im Projekt-Team in Darmstadt erwartet Sie eine Karriere, die Innovation mit Qualitätssicherung verbindet. Hier ist Ihre Expertise in der Erstellung von Testplänen, der Durchführung von Systemtests und der Optimierung von Softwareentwicklungsprozessen gefragt.
### **So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei**
- **Erstellung von Testplänen und -spezifikationen**: Sie definieren Anforderungen, bewerten Risiken, bestimmen die Testumgebungen und setzen Qualitätsziele für die medizinische Software fest. Zudem erstellen und dokumentieren Sie detaillierte Testentwürfe, Testfälle und Testskripte.
- **Planung und Durchführung von Tests**: Durch sorgfältig geplante Systemtests und den Einsatz von Testautomatisierung erhöhen Sie die Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit von Softwarelösungen in der Medizintechnik.
- **Auswertung und Dokumentation**: Sie analysieren die Testergebnisse und sorgen für eine umfassende Dokumentation, um höchste Qualitätsstandards sicherzustellen.
- **Entwicklung von Komponenten**: Sie entwickeln mechanische und elektromechanische Komponenten zur Unterstützung der Testautomatisierung und für Langzeittests.
- **Qualitätsmanagement**: Ihr Aufgabengebiet wird durch die Optimierung von Softwareentwicklungsprozessen und die Qualitätssicherung im regulierten Umfeld abgerundet.
### **Das bringen Sie mit**
- **Abgeschlossene Ausbildung**: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Qualifizierung als Fachinformatiker:in oder eine vergleichbare Befähigung.
- **Erfahrung im Testing**: Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Software-Test und in der Validierung.
- **Kompetenz mit Test-Tools**: Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Software-Test-Tools, insbesondere im Anforderungsmanagement und Bugtracking.
- **Kenntnisse in Software und Datenbanken**: Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit .NET-basierter Software sowie ausgeprägtes Know-how im Umgang mit MS SQL Server.
- **Netzwerkbetreuung**: Praktische Erfahrung in der Administration von Netzwerken sowie umfassende Kompetenz in der Handhabung von Windows-Betriebssystemen (XP, 7, 8, 10).
- **Sprachkenntnisse**: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- **ISTQB Foundation Level-Zertifizierung vorteilhaft:** Ihre Kenntnisse in der Elektronik und Ihr Wissen als zertifizierte Softwaretester:in, hilft Ihnen dabei, Softwaresysteme auf ihre Qualität und Funktion hin zu überprüfen, Fehler zu beheben und Anwendungen zu verbessern.
### **Was wir bieten**
- **Attraktive Konditionen**: Freuen Sie sich auf eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle bei BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING in Darmstadt, mit einer Vergütung, die Ihre Expertise würdigt.
- **Innovationsführerschaft**: Nehmen Sie eine führende Rolle in der Medizintechnik ein und treiben Sie die Optimierung hochwertiger Diagnoseprodukte voran, die wirklich einen Unterschied machen.
- **Dynamisches Team**: Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das Wert auf persönliches Wachstum und eine unterstützende Arbeitskultur legt.
**Sie sind interessiert?**
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung an:
bewerbung@brueggen-engineering.de
Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Herr Dipl.-Ing. (FH) Christian Bitz

items.jobDescription:
Wer wir sind
 Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software- und IT-Dienstleister mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.
 Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Du arbeitest in einem Team aus Pega-Architekten und -Entwicklern bei einem großen Konzern. Das Team digitalisiert und automatisiert Geschäftsprozesse auf der Pega-Plattform, von der ersten Idee bis zum Betrieb.
 Fachliche Workshops leiten, Anforderungen aufnehmen und strukturieren
 Geschäftsprozesse, Workflows und Case-Management-Lösungen in Pega Infinity konzipieren und modellieren
 Daten-, Entscheidungs- und Geschäftslogik entwerfen und in Pega umsetzen und konfigurieren
 Kunden zu Pega Best Practices beraten
 Pega Blueprint für Konzeption und Lösungsdesign einsetzen

 Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

 Das erwarten wir: 
 Zertifikat Pega Certified Business Architect (CBA)
 Zertifikat Pega Certified System Architect (CSA)
 Mehr als fünf Jahre Projekterfahrung mit Pega Infinity 8.x oder höher
 Mehr als drei Jahre Erfahrung als Business Architect in Pega-Projekten
 Von Vorteil (kein Muss): 
 Erfahrung mit Pega Blueprint oder Pega GenAI

 Erfahrung als Berater in der Prozessdigitalisierung

 Überwiegend remote, dazu Büro, wenn du magst
 MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
 Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte

 Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

PP, WM/EWM) und deren Integration mit MES-Systemen von Vorteil; Erfahrung in der Bewertung und Umsetzung von funktionalen Anforderungen innerhalb von Standardlösungen (z. B. SAP DM); Grundverständnis von Schnittstellen und IT-/OT-Integration; Kenntnisse im Bereich IT-Infrastruktur (z. B. Netzwerke, Server, IP-basierte Kommunikation) von Vorteil

 Der Bereich Electronic Warfare Ground Support Solutions ist für die Konzeption, Umsetzung, Integration und Abnahme von Bodenunterstützungssystemen zuständig.
Dabei handelt es sich um Softwarelösungen, die unsere Kunden bei der Programmierung und Verifikation ihrer Electronic-Warfare-Systeme unterstützen. In diesem Zusammenhang erweitern wir bestehende Lösungen, entwickeln neue Systeme für unsere Kunden und treiben Innovationen im Rahmen von Studien voran.
 Ihre Aufgaben
 Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Abstimmung der übergeordneten Systemarchitektur und des technischen Gesamtdesigns
 Definition, Abstimmung und Nachverfolgung von Systemanforderungen und technischen Lösungen der Bodenunterstützungssysteme
 Integration der Sytemebausteine in eine konsistente Gesamtlösung
 Bewertung der Systemkonzepte hinsichtlich technischer Machbarkeit, Leistungsfähigkeit, Risiken und Integrationsfähigkeit

 Ihr Profil
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Fachrichtung Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Nachrichtentechnik, Elektrotechnik, oder Vergleichbares
 Langjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung technischer Systemarchitekturen und -konzepten für komplexe Softwareprojekte
 Weitreichende Erfahrung im Bereich Systems Engineering und Systemmodellierung
 Kenntnisse im Bereich Electronic Warfare, idealerweise im Bereich Missionsdatenverarbeitung wünscheswert
 Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Prozessen bei der SW-Entwicklung

 We work hard for the people who work for us. We champion our teams and foster collaboration, inclusion, respect and excellence. Because we want to be more for you.

 They’re the secret to our success—empowered, inventive and inclusive. Passionate about their craft. Driven to succeed. Because we win together.
 Are you ready for a better career? A better future?
 Aufgabenbereich 
 Als Teil des EU- & Afrika-JIT-&-Structures-AME-Teams unterstützt der Intralogistik-Automatisierungsingenieur die Umsetzung von Projekten gemäß den definierten Standards und der AME Intralogistics Automation (ILA) Roadmap von Lear. Die Projekte werden entsprechend gruppiert, um eine kontinuierliche und effiziente Projektabwicklung sicherzustellen.   
 In dieser Funktion übernimmt der Stelleninhaber eine wichtige Rolle innerhalb des AME-Teams und unterstützt die Implementierung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Projekten in den Werken der Region Europa und Afrika. Weitere Aufgaben umfassen die Sicherstellung der Projektumsetzung nach Lear-Standards, die technische Abstimmung mit Lieferanten, die Erstellung von Arbeitsanweisungen und technischen Spezifikationen für die Werke sowie die Identifikation von Schulungsbedarfen innerhalb der Standorte.   
 Als Teil des Intralogistik-Teams unterstützt diese Position die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Automatisierungsprojekten innerhalb der Organisation.   
 Verantwortungsbereiche 
 Zusammenarbeit & Stakeholder-Management     
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem zentralen ILA Competence Center, den Werken, EHS, Einkauf, IT und den kommerziellen Teams, um die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Automatisierungsprojekten sicherzustellen.     
 Teilnahme an strategischen Abstimmungen zu Umsetzungsstrategie, Zeitplanung und Implementierung von ILA-Projekten.     
 Unterstützung des RFQ-Prozesses durch technische und operative Expertise.     
 Projektbegründung & Business Case Entwicklung     
 Zusammenarbeit mit den Werken zur Identifikation klarer Business Cases und operativer Anforderungen für Intralogistik-Automatisierungsprojekte.     
 Sicherstellung, dass alle Projektunterlagen vollständig, korrekt und für alle relevanten Stakeholder verständlich sind.     
 Standardisierung & Technische Spezifikationen     
 Entwicklung und Pflege von Automatisierungsstandards in Zusammenarbeit mit dem AME ILA-Team.     
 Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Einführung technischer Spezifikationen sowie standardisierter Lösungen (z. B. Intralogistics Automation Playbook) über verschiedene Standorte und Programme hinweg.     
 Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Lear-Standards und Best Practices während der gesamten Projektumsetzung.     
 Inbetriebnahme & Technische Unterstützung     
 Leitung und Unterstützung der Inbetriebnahme freigegebener Intralogistik-Automatisierungslösungen (z. B. AGV/AMR, ASRS, E-Kanban, RTLS usw.).     
 Technische Unterstützung (Software und Hardware) für lokale Instandhaltungsteams und Key User während Inbetriebnahme und Hochlaufphase.     
 Unterstützung der Werke bei Anpassungen und Prozessverbesserungen bestehender Automatisierungssysteme.     
 Schulung & Wissenstransfer      
 Coaching der Werksteams durch Weitergabe von Best Practices und Lessons Learned.     
 Unterstützung bei Anlauf, Schulungen und Erstellung kundenspezifischer Dokumentation, um eine reibungslose Übergabe und nachhaltigen Betrieb sicherzustellen.     
 weitere Verantwortungsbereiche:
 Leistungsüberwachung & Kontinuierliche Verbesserung    
 Erhebung und Analyse von Leistungs- und Sicherheitskennzahlen zur Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen.     
 Kommunikation mit externen Integratoren und Lieferanten zur Lösung technischer Probleme und Verbesserung der Systemleistung.     
 Dokumentation von Lessons Learned zur Optimierung zukünftiger Projekte.     
 Arbeitssicherheit & Compliance     
 Sicherstellung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds sowie der Einhaltung aller relevanten EHS-Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Verfahren.     
 Unterstützung der sicheren und ordnungsgemäßen Installation von Anlagen und Einrichtungen in den Werken.     
 Projektmanagement & Reporting      
 Regelmäßiges Reporting an ILA-, Projekt- und Werksmanagement gemäß den definierten iDEA-Projektmanagementstandards.     
 Sicherstellung fehlerfreier Projektanläufe ohne Kundenauswirkungen durch professionelle Projektumsetzung.     
 Erforderliche fachliche und persönliche Kompetenzen 
 Technisches Studium sowie Erfahrung im Bereich Automatisierung; Kenntnisse von IT-Systemen (z. B. ERP, MES, WMS, WCS, WES usw.) sind von Vorteil.      
 Erfahrung im Manufacturing Engineering, Continuous Improvement oder Projektmanagement.      
 Erfahrung mit Industrie-4.0- und Intralogistik-Automatisierungsprojekten in einem produzierenden Unternehmen.      
 Ausgeprägte Problemlösungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.      
 Sicheres Auftreten und Fähigkeit, auf allen Unternehmensebenen zu präsentieren.      
 Hohe Motivation und Lernbereitschaft; unterschiedliche Profile mit Entwicklungspotenzial sind willkommen.      
 Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Detailgenauigkeit.      
 Verständnis für LEAR-IT-Systeme und Logistikkonzepte.      
 Selbstsicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kollegen, Teamleitern sowie Ansprechpartnern aus Werken und zentralen Funktionen.      
 Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint.     
 Wünschenswerte Qualifikationen 
 Erfahrung im Projektmanagement inklusive Budgetverantwortung.   
 Kenntnisse der ISO- und CE-Zertifizierungsanforderungen für Intralogistik-Anwendungen.   
 Kenntnisse im Lean Management.   
 Ausbildung & Berufserfahrung 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium im technischen Bereich, z. B. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbare Fachrichtung.    
 Erfahrung mit Industrie-4.0-Projekten, insbesondere im Bereich Intralogistik, in einem produzierenden Unternehmen ist ein großer Vorteil.    
 Mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Industrial Engineering, Automatisierung, Robotik, Continuous Improvement oder Lean Management.    
 Verhandlungssichere Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.    
 Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb der EMEA-Region von bis zu 25 %.

 Applicants must submit their resume for consideration using our applicant tracking system. Due to the high volume of applications received, only candidates selected for interviews

items.jobDescription:
Notre équipe Warehouse Dispatch & Fulfillment recherche un·e Software Integration Engineer (f/m/d) basé·e à Villeneuve-d'Ascq. 
 Au sein de la Business Unit PRISM, notre défi est d'optimiser l'équation stock/disponibilité des produits dans nos entrepôts grâce à FAST, un algorithme spécifique complexe développé dans SAP ECC.
 En tant que Software Integration Engineer, tu agis en véritable Consultant SAP technico-fonctionnel pour traduire les besoins métiers en solutions robustes et faire évoluer ce produit au cœur de la Supply Chain de Decathlon.
 TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 
 Tu es garant·e de la conception, de l'évolution et de l'intégration de la solution FAST :
 Conception & Spécifications : Tu traduis les besoins métiers en spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques détaillées. Tu assures la pérennité et la documentation de la solution.
 Maîtrise du Standard & Évolutions : Tu possèdes une forte connaissance du standard SAP ECC. Tu sais quand t'appuyer sur le standard et quand faire évoluer les spécifications du spécifique FAST pour répondre aux stratégies d'approvisionnement.
 Accompagnement & Tests : Tu collabores étroitement avec les développeurs pour garantir la qualité des livraisons et tu orchestres les tests de bout en bout (E2E) et de non-régression.
 Cet algorithme sera fortement challengé à l'avenir par notre transformation supply et logistique , ces évolutions devront se baser sur les concepts du standard MM de SAP, et opportunités de S4.
 CE QUE TU APPORTES 
 Expertise : Tu as une solide expérience en tant que consultant·e technico-fonctionnel·le SAP, idéalement sur les modules logistiques.
 Méthodologie : Tu as une excellente capacité à rédiger des spécifications claires et à comprendre la technique (la capacité à lire/comprendre de l'ABAP est un vrai plus).
 Architecture & Flux : Tu possèdes des notions indispensables en API Management (APIM) pour interagir de manière robuste avec notre écosystème.
 Langues : Tu maîtrises l'anglais (B2 minimum) pour interagir dans un contexte international.
 STACK TECHNIQUE 
 ERP : SAP ECC/S4 MM, Algorithme FAST (Spécifique), connaissance de SD est un plus
 Langages : Notions ABAP (lecture, debug)
 Flux & API : API Management (APIM), requêtes et tests d'API avec Bruno, interfaces standards et spécifiques
 Productivité & IA : Utilisation d'assistants au quotidien pour l'analyse et la rédaction (SAP Joule, VSCode avec plugin Copilot) et veille technologique (expérimentations MCP)
 CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS 
 Organisation de travail hybride ;
 Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
 Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
 Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
 Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).
 NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE 
 Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable: c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.
 Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement"
 DECATHLON DIGITAL  
 Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.
 Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.
